job.title: Digitalization Delivery Engineer
job.description:
As a Digitalisation Delivery Engineer based in Singapore, you will be the bridge between the physical and digital sides of a building. You will verify that the MEP and spatial data feeding our platform is accurate and complete, so our AI agents can reason and act with precision, setting the delivery standard for our expansion across 50+ markets.

About Janus Digital

Janus Digital™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. It is built on 15+ years of foundational R&D, 76 granted patents and over $100M invested, and is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities and 10+ asset classes, offices, hotels, shopping centres, hospitals, data centres and more. We work on an outcome-based model: we earn on the verified value the platform creates.

What you will do

  • Verify spatial and MEP equipment data (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire, security and building automation) against physical buildings, and register accurate equipment and relationship data on our delivery platform.
  • Encode IoT point lists, prepare protocol-specific binding tables, configure gateways and commission multi-protocol communications (BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA, KNX).
  • Run self- and peer-reviews so every deliverable meets our global quality benchmarks (precision ≥95%, completeness ≥98%, IoT connectivity ≥95%, data accuracy ≥98%) before client submission.
  • Work closely with Project Managers on delivery planning, BIM Modellers on model accuracy, and Solution Architects on platform configuration.
  • Diagnose and resolve on-site delivery issues, from model-to-reality discrepancies to multi-protocol IoT integration problems.

What you will bring

  • 2+ years' hands-on experience in MEP design, construction, building digitalisation, BIM delivery, Building Management Systems (BMS) or IoT/smart-building deployment. Candidates from MEP design or construction backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical/electrical drawings, identify equipment in the field and understand system relationship hierarchies.
  • Working proficiency with Revit, CAD and IFC drawing interpretation, with an understanding of spatial hierarchies and asset relationship models.
  • Practical experience with IoT communication protocols and commissioning tools (for example BACnetScan, Modbus Master, NetAssist, UAExpert, MqttInsight).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional, multicultural teams.

Nice to have

  • Professional English fluency (Mandarin a strong advantage).
  • A Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services), Facilities Management, IT or a related technical field is a plus, though not required if you bring strong hands-on experience.
  • Hands-on wire-level debugging of IoT protocols.
  • Practical knowledge of day-to-day building operations and maintenance.

Why join Janus Digital

Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives tied to delivery quality and client outcomes. A specialist role at the frontier of agentic AI and autonomous building intelligence. Hands-on exposure to a diverse portfolio of commercial offices, hotels, malls and mixed-use developments. Direct collaboration with our global Solution Architecture team and access to a worldwide knowledge base. Clear progression into senior consulting or regional delivery leadership. Sponsorship for professional development, including certifications in building services and energy management.

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
As Senior Project Manager, you're the first responsible person for turning our AI vision into a physical reality, not just managing a timeline but orchestrating the transformation of a building into a fully autonomous, AI-governed asset. Based in London, you'll own a project's financial performance, technical scope, regulatory compliance and risk profile from initiation through to full autonomous operation, bridging the deterministic world of mechanical and electrical engineering with the probabilistic world of generative AI.

About Janus Digital

Janus Digital™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. It is built on 15+ years of foundational R&D, 76 granted patents and over $100M invested, and is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities and 10+ asset classes, offices, hotels, shopping centres, hospitals, data centres and more. We work on an outcome-based model: we earn on the verified value the platform creates.

What you will do

  • Own the full project lifecycle, initiation through closing, with total accountability for P&L, margin and revenue realisation.
  • Define the Work Breakdown Structure for complex building automation and legacy-system integration projects, and manage delivery across multiple concurrent sites.
  • Oversee installation of IoT devices, gateways and BMS integrations, coordinating MEP reviews to identify infrastructure limitations before deployment.
  • Manage the transition from supervised AI operation to reliable autonomy, working with AgentOps engineers on telemetry, monitoring and escalation design.
  • Identify and mitigate cyber-physical risk, and manage project change requests against budget, timeline and compliance.
  • Ensure delivery meets the UK regulatory landscape (BREEAM, the Building Safety Act 2022, ISO 19650, UK GDPR) in partnership with specialist teams.
  • Coordinate Solution Architects, Delivery Engineers and AI/ML teams to unify physical, digital and regulatory workstreams.
  • Train the trainer: Project manager should have experience in training people. Creating training programmes and delivering training.

What you will bring

  • 8+ years of experience within a Building Management Systems, MEP or construction/technology delivery environment.
  • Project Management certification, PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent.
  • Exceptional leadership, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to stay decisive under high-pressure, on-site conditions.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Right to work in the UK.

Nice to have

  • Proven, demonstrable ownership of project P&L: costing, risk and profit-and-loss accountability.
  • Agile/Scrum delivery experience (PMI-ACP or CSM).
  • Technical literacy in structured digital building models, BIM, ISO 19650 and smart building protocols (BACnet, Modbus, KNX).
  • Working knowledge of converged IT/OT security and data-privacy frameworks (UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018).
  • Experience within the UK building or construction sector.
  • Chartered status or membership of a relevant professional body (CIBSE, IET, RICS or APM).

job.title: BMS Delivery Engineer
job.description:
As a Digitalisation Delivery Engineer, you're the engineer who turns physical buildings into the structured, high-fidelity data models our agentic AI operates on, and increasingly, the engineer who trains and certifies the client and partner teams who take over platform operation after you. Working hands-on with Project Managers and BIM Modellers, you'll own delivery of both static building data and dynamic IoT data on live projects, then hand off your expertise through structured training and certification. Your work determines whether a building can run autonomously, and whether the partners who take it from there are equipped to keep it that way.

About Janus Digital

Janus Digital™ is the agentic AI platform that runs the world's real assets. It is built on 15+ years of foundational R&D, 76 granted patents and over $100M invested, and is live across 10,000+ building datasets in 253 cities and 10+ asset classes, offices, hotels, shopping centres, hospitals, data centres and more. We work on an outcome-based model: we earn on the verified value the platform creates.

What you will do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of building data models: as-built drawing collection, BIM verification against physical sites, spatial and MEP equipment registration, relationship mapping, QR code tagging and final client acceptance.
  • Execute the full IoT delivery workflow: point list encoding, binding table preparation, gateway configuration and protocol commissioning across BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA and KNX.
  • Bind IoT data points to their building models, verify data accuracy and connectivity, and commission complete subsystems: energy metering, lighting, chiller/AHU controls and environmental monitoring, end to end.
  • Train and certify client and partner engineers, including property managers, hotel operators and shopping centre administrators, to configure, operate and maintain the platform independently after handover, through a mix of virtual, in-person and hands-on lab sessions.
  • Own recertification for every partner team you've trained, running annual refreshers to keep operational and data-quality standards consistent across sites.
  • Meet global quality benchmarks (data precision ≥95%, completeness ≥98%, IoT connectivity ≥95%, accuracy ≥98%) through rigorous self- and peer-review before client submission.
  • Collaborate daily with Project Managers, BIM Modellers and Solution Architects on delivery planning, model accuracy and platform configuration.
  • Diagnose and resolve field issues, including BIM-to-reality discrepancies, multi-protocol IoT integration problems and data-modelling edge cases, escalating complex cases to Tier-3 support.

What you will bring

  • 2+ years' hands-on experience in building MEP design, construction, building digitalisation, BIM delivery, Building Management Systems, IoT deployment, or smart building technology.
  • Solid understanding of building MEP systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, security, building automation/DDC), with the ability to read mechanical/electrical drawings and identify equipment on site.
  • Working proficiency with BIM tools (Revit) and CAD/IFC drawing interpretation.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistent data-quality standards across large data volumes.
  • Understanding of IoT communication protocols (BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA) and practical experience with IoT deployment or device commissioning.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in cross-functional, multicultural project teams.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • Right to work in the UK.
  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services), Facilities Management, Information Technology, or a related field.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing or delivering technical training or certification programmes to external or non-technical audiences.
  • Coaching, presentation and training-delivery skills, comfortable teaching technical content clearly to partner audiences, including those who don't have English as a first language.
  • Working knowledge of UK building standards and CIBSE guidance (Part L, Part F, TM44).
  • Wire-level IoT protocol debugging experience (BACnetScan, Modbus Master, UAExpert, MqttInsight or similar).
  • Facility management or building operations experience.
  • Strong structured-data thinking: translating complex MEP hierarchies into clear, machine-readable classifications.
  • Prior field delivery experience on construction sites or in commissioning environments.

Why join Janus Digital

Every building on the planet is running below its potential You'll be one of the engineers closing that gap, building by building, as part of Janus Digital's first UK cohort Compensation is competitive and performance-based, tied to delivery quality and outcomes You'll get comprehensive training through Janus Digital's newly developed platform certification programme, helping shape it as part of the first cohort, ahead of its rollout to other regional offices, and hands-on experience across commercial offices, hotels, shopping centres and mixed-use developments Your scope grows with you: as you take on more training and certification ownership for partner teams, your seniority and career path grow with it, from Delivery Engineer to Senior Engineer, with routes into regional lead or specialist roles, plus certification sponsorship for BIM, IoT and related credentials.
